description:
Search for bills in Congress by keyword, congress number, or bill type. Returns bill number, title, sponsor, latest action, and status.

With `query`: full-text search of bill text via GovInfo, ranked by relevance — supports quoted phrases and AND/OR (e.g., '"artificial intelligence" AND privacy'). Returns up to 20 distinct bills per call; use offset for more. fromDateTime/toDateTime/sort apply only when listing without a query.
Without `query`: lists bills by most recent update.

Congress numbers: 119th (2025-2026), 118th (2023-2024), 117th (2021-2022).
Bill types: hr (House), s (Senate), hjres, sjres, hconres, sconres, hres, sres

congress.description: Congress number (e.g., 119 for 2025-2026). Omit to search/list across all congresses

fromDateTime.description: Listing only: filter by update date from this timestamp. Format: YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z

limit.description: Max results (default: 20; keyword searches return at most 20)

query.description: Full-text keyword search of bill text (e.g., 'infrastructure', '"tax credit" AND solar'). Omit to list recent bills

toDateTime.description: Listing only: filter by update date to this timestamp. Format: YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z

name: congress_search_bills
